request.description: Publishes an approved version, now or at `effectiveFrom`. New leads and leads that become routable are offered by the worker straight away; existing offers keep the version they were made under. Staff only. Routing rules are versioned config (same lifecycle as question sets): an ops lead makes, a different staff member approves in Change Requests, then it is published. Reading needs config read access; making, publishing and retiring need config maker access for routing rules (ops lead, super admin).

response.name: 200 OK
